newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-BELEAGUERED FALLON RIDES FOUR WINNERS FOR CECIL.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-BELEAGUERED FALLON RIDES FOUR WINNERS FOR CECIL.

text.p: sticking with stable jockey Kieren Fallon despite deep disappointment over his riding of Bosra Sham in the Eclipse Stakes on Saturday when the horse finished third after starting hot favourite.

Fallon replied by riding four winners for Cecil at Newmarket on Wednesday at combined odds of 32-1, though he was outshone on the day by Saudi owner Prince Khalid Abdullah who had five successes on the seven-race card.

Discussing Saturday's Eclipse Stakes where Fallon was boxed in at a crucial stage in the five-runner race, Cecil told Channel 4 TV on Wednesday: "I think he did make a mistake but it doesn't mean you cut somebody's throat."
Fallon has lost the rides on Bosra Sham, described at Royal Ascot by Cecil as the best horse he has trained, and last year's Oaks winner Lady Carla. Both are owned by Syrian businessman Wafic Said.
But Cecil said: "Of course he will be retained as stable jockey next year, there has never been any question."
